changes.new_value: Fixed 2026-08-07. Root cause of the phantom "page not found" (B1/B2/B5): update/delete/task handlers resolved pages ONLY through the in-memory graph index and hard-errored when it was stale, while get had a disk fallback. Fix: added resolve_page_meta() (graph-first, disk-fallback via project_root) in page_crud_service.rs; wired into update_page_with_repo + wm_task handle_get/update/delete. Also fixed a second bug the regression test exposed: PageUpdateParams.title was declared but never applied (title never landed on disk). Regression test update_works_with_stale_graph_index in e2e_mcp.rs writes pages directly to disk (bypassing index) and asserts wm_page.update + wm_task.update succeed and persist. Full wm-core suite: 295 tests pass.
